description: Presidential Secretariat - Proclamations of a by the President Establishment of a Presidential Task Force.
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific named individuals (e.g., Dr. N. S. Kumanayake, Commander of the Army, W. L. A. Saman Priyantha, etc.) AND detailed descriptions of their responsibilities and tasks for the "Clean Sri Lanka" Programme. The content includes both the "who" (government personnel appointments) and the "what" (specific portfolio responsibilities and implementation tasks), making it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
